description:
Create a PERT chart (Program Evaluation and Review Technique) for a 'System Migration Project'. 

Starting from the EdrawMax home screen, create a new drawing (use a blank drawing or a PERT/Project Management template). 

Add 10 activity nodes with the following details (calculate Expected Time 'Te' using formula (O + 4M + P) / 6, rounded to 1 decimal):

1. ID: A, Name: 'Requirements Gathering', O:2, M:3, P:5
2. ID: B, Name: 'System Analysis', O:3, M:4, P:6
3. ID: C, Name: 'Hardware Procurement', O:4, M:6, P:10
4. ID: D, Name: 'Database Design', O:2, M:3, P:4
5. ID: E, Name: 'Application Development', O:6, M:8, P:12
6. ID: F, Name: 'Test Environment Setup', O:1, M:2, P:3
7. ID: G, Name: 'Data Migration', O:2, M:4, P:6
8. ID: H, Name: 'Integration Testing', O:3, M:4, P:6
9. ID: I, Name: 'User Acceptance Testing', O:2, M:3, P:4
10. ID: J, Name: 'Go-Live Deployment', O:1, M:1, P:2

Connect the nodes with arrows based on these dependencies:
- A -> B, A -> C
- B -> D, B -> E
- D -> E, C -> F
- D -> G, F -> G
- E -> H, G -> H
- H -> I
- I -> J

Add a title 'ERP System Migration - PERT Chart' at the top.

Save the editable file to '/home/ga/Diagrams/pert_migration.eddx' and export an image to '/home/ga/Diagrams/pert_migration.png'.
